summary: Console features and guest tools observation: send key combinations, fit/actual/resize-to-window display modes, quality presets, view only, screenshots, reconnect, full screen with toolbar, console-only window, clipboard in both directions and Type into VM in the shared console component; new VM definitions add the qemu-vdagent clipboard channel, USB tablet and VirtIO display; Core observes per-VM guest agent facts and channel readiness which Controller shows in a Guest tools panel, including an install advisory (Linux and Windows) when a running VM has no responding agent. API impact: changed contract (report inventory vms[].guest and guest check; VM list guest member); console routes unchanged.

guide.reason: The console toolbar gains send keys, display modes, clipboard, typing, screenshots, view only, reconnect and a console-only window; a new page documents installing the guest tools and reading the Guest tools panel, with troubleshooting for missing channels and agents.

api.reason: Report inventory gains vms[].guest (GuestInfo, GuestAddress) and the guest check; GET /api/v1/vms passes guest through. OpenAPI schemas and the generated reference are updated with the contract test; the console routes are unchanged and documented as existing contract with the new VM definition devices.

verification.method: go test -race ./... (definition devices, guest observation parsing, snapshot attachment, VM list pass-through), go vet, Python contract and documentation checks, UI typecheck/build, and tests/integration/console_features_lab.py: a disposable nested-KVM lab copy with a Debian 13 guest whose guest tools were installed by cloud-init, driving the Guest tools panel and every console toolbar feature in Playwright with guest-exec checks inside the guest for send keys, typed text and clipboard contents; results, captures and limits in the QA report.
